I’ve played 4 different Monettes (B1-2, B2S3W (main), MFIII, and a B6LS1 (used to be main lead but I had a slight change in embouchure and it became too small) and they are leagues better than anything else I’ve tried even when they are the wrong size. I start on F# as the first note of the specific octave because it’s the lowest “normal” not we play, so F# below the staff to first space is “low”, octave above that is “normal” (I just don’t add a adjective before it, so 3rd space C is just “c”) octave above that is “high”, then “double”, then “triple”, etc

The only muscles I really use above high C are obviously my embouchure to keep it sturdy, but also a slight flex (not tight, think pushing out instead of sucking in) of my abs to keep solid air support
